headline: Iran increases threat to Strait of Hormuz shipping, and other Middle East developments
summary: Iran appears to be targeting vessels carrying out ship-to-ship oil transfers around the Strait of Hormuz, according to a military institute. The threat raises risk for oil shipments through the strait.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil transit chokepoints, and disruption there can quickly lift crude prices and shipping insurance costs.
why_moved: Reported Iranian targeting of ship-to-ship oil transfers around Hormuz raises the risk of supply disruption, which typically lifts crude prices.
